about.bio1: I'm Vanshika Sabharwal, an open-source contributor for the past 2+ years.
about.bio2: I've completed two internships so far — one with the US-based organization The Palisadoes Foundation, and the second with the Bengaluru-based company Desklinq.
about.bio3: I have experience working with both international and national teams, which has helped me improve my management and communication skills, along with my proficiency in languages.
about.bio4: I am fluent in English and Hindi, and I'm currently working on my Turkish and Japanese. I've contributed to open source repositories such as MetaCall and The Palisadoes Foundation, both of which frequently appear in Google Summer of Code (GSoC).
